kind.description: premium_requests (Copilot), turns (Codex, Claude Code), or harness-reported unit

applied.description: NEW: false when errors kept the previous policy active

models.description: NEW: capability probe results for action=test

workflow.delivered.description: NEW (ID-02): a post-run delivery action completed successfully

remote.description: remote name; URL sanitized in tool events

call_id.description: NEW: host tool call of this delivery

estimated.description: NEW (A11): token counts estimated because the provider sent no usage

details.description: NEW (A11): redacted raw provider error; never in model context

proposals.description: NEW (A10 §5.6): every tool proposal of the response

marker_hash.description: NEW (A10): hash of the per-step untrusted-data marker; the marker itself is never persisted

taint_sources.description: NEW: untrusted sources that influenced the action (e.g. README.md), WRD-11 §2.3

question.description: NEW: redacted question text for kind question

options.description: NEW: suggested answers for kind question

answer.description: NEW (ID-05): redacted answer to a question; scope is null then

limits.description: A06 §13.2 defines the members (memory_mb, pids, cpus, fsize_mb, tmp_mb, cgroup, seccomp)

socket.description: sha256 of the host socket path

profile_digest.description: NEW (A06): sha256 of the Seatbelt profile or the bwrap argv JSON

proxy.connect.description: Emitted when the tunnel or request closes (A07 §3)

purpose.description: A15 values: model_call, provider_test, checkpoint_sign, provider_add_verify

ref.description: NEW: call_id or artifact_id the redaction applied to

record_hash.description: NEW: sha256 of JCS(artifact record), binds provenance to the chain

uncommitted.description: A14 §3 step 7: changes left untouched in the user's working tree

ref.description: NEW (A14): e.g. refs/warden/partial/<task_key>/<attempt> for label partial

trigger.description: NEW; ID-14 triggers plus the mechanics of §11.1
